prompt: GNU diff expand-tabs encoding error column width treatment
answer:
With GNU `diff --expand-tabs` (`-t`):

- Tabs are converted to the appropriate number of spaces before output.
- Column counting uses the locale-defined width of each character.
- Each encoding-error byte—an input byte that is not part of any character—is counted as one column.
- GNU `diff` assumes the output device honors tab stops and displays characters using the operating system’s column widths.

These assumptions can cause output alignment to differ for encoding errors or non-ASCII characters if the display device behaves differently. [[GNU diff Internationalization](https://www.gnu.org/software/diffutils/manual/html_node/Internationalization.html)] [[GNU diff Tabs](http://www.gnu.org/software/diffutils/manual/html_node/Tabs.html)]
